participation.context: Kept one book, refused a hem, and left the morning on Navarre.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Counted seven days, no bill, and no seamstress.
participation.name: John Heminges

participation.context: Asked for a laugh and a hat, and got neither.
participation.name: Will Kemp

participation.context: Set Sam on the breath, and stopped him when clear was enough.
participation.name: Augustine Phillips

participation.context: Sang the cuckoo clear, and stood quiet when told.
participation.name: Sam Latchet

participation.context: Named two split hooks and agreed to turn slower.
participation.name: Arthur Meeks

participation.context: Refused another version and kept the plot where it hung.
participation.name: Abel Garnish

participation.context: Mentioned. She was not sent for, and she did not let a hem down.
participation.name: Edith Kettlewood

relations.quote: Sing it on the breath, not on the word.
The slip is on. One book.

story.body: You left the paste where it was and the hooks where they were. Sam's note was clear. Kemp went without a new laugh. You named no other play.
